detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Just when you thought the Goat Simulator 3 world couldn’t get more enchanting.

We’ve added 20 new magical gears to get you brewing with excitement.

6 with abilities, 1 new vehicle, and 5 new instincts, sounds wand-erful, right?

You can finally have a friend, at least in the game

A new vehicle that will sweep you off your feet

Unlike other magical worlds, everyone is welcome here
